# AurumAI — External Review

AurumAI is a Market Intelligence Operating System focused initially on gold and macroeconomic markets. It is not positioned as a trading bot.

The product is institutional intelligence: transforming historical and current observations into structured lessons, knowledge records, evidence, reasoning, and explainable institutional assessments.

## Current position

AurumAI has substantial core intelligence, production-hardening, paper-trading, lineage, forecasting, risk, OOS-evaluation, and institutional-experiment infrastructure.

The current engineering focus is validation rather than feature accumulation.

**External rule:** do not describe AurumAI as profitable, live-trading ready, or institutionally validated unless a current reproducible artifact supports the claim.
